world.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original production-quality background for a high-end Greek myth slot game, wide cinematic landscape image about 2:1, 2048 pixels wide if possible.
Primary request: an atmospheric storm-lit ancient Greek temple floating above deep-blue clouds, ivory marble colonnades and antique gold ornament, with a commanding sculptural white-bearded thunder god on the FAR RIGHT. Original character and composition, never copied commercial game artwork.
Composition: left and middle 70 percent must remain calm, dark midnight-blue, softly detailed negative space for a 6-column by 5-row reel board overlay. The environment is actual painted architecture and clouds, not an empty gradient. Tall worn ivory columns frame the left edge and distant temple terrace. Keep any architectural arch OUT of the center and no frames or grids. At the rightmost 25 percent, place the waist-up powerful mature god, long flowing white beard, white windswept hair, antique gold laurel, ivory draped toga, carved golden shoulder clasp, muscular forearm. Sculptural painted character with believable anatomy and dignified face. Blue-white lightning illuminates his right hand near lower-right. His entire head stays visible inside image, never cropped by top. Main character stays far right and does not invade central-left reel region.
Style: beautifully hand-painted 2.5D volumetric game concept art, mature cinematic quality, rich material texture and realistic painterly modeling, dramatic depth, ethereal electric storm clouds, thin warm gold rimlight and cold blue stormlight. Palette ivory, aged antique gold, deep ultramarine and midnight blue. Sharpest details on god and marble edges, subtly defocused background.
Constraints: NO text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, user interface, slots, game board, reels, grid, central arch, no thick cartoon outlines, no flat vector shapes, no emoji, no cheap plastic look. Clean art background only. Wide landscape.

atlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL high-end Greek mythology game icon SPRITE ATLAS on true transparent alpha background. A landscape sheet EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, 4:3 canvas preferably 2048x1536. Exactly 12 separated symbols in strict reading order. The twelve imaginary square cells are never drawn. Each object perfectly centered in its own square cell, longest dimension 75% of the cell, with big transparent gutters on all sides. No overlap, no object crosses a cell boundary.
Style: premium hand-painted 2.5D volumetric game illustration, rich sculptural antique gold, luminous faceted gemstones, ivory and royal blue, coherent warm top-left key light with cool blue rim. Tactile metal engraving, convincing painted material depth, bright crisp strong readable silhouettes at 40px. No flat vector, no cheap plastic, no cartoon outlines, no emoji. Individual icons, no plaques beneath them except specified emblem.
Exact symbol order:
Row1 col1: majestic antique golden crown with sapphire and ruby jewels, ivory inner lining, wide compact silhouette.
Row1 col2: thick elegant antique gold ring bearing one large square sapphire, tilted three-quarter view, ring loop clearly visible.
Row1 col3: ornate golden hourglass with white sand in clear glass, symmetrical compact silhouette.
Row1 col4: magnificent embossed golden chalice filled with red wine, flared cup and stable small foot, no text.
Row2 col1: one large red faceted ruby in rounded heart shape, no metal frame.
